summary: Pioneer Bancorp, through its subsidiary, completed the acquisition of 100% of Targeted Lending Co., LLC for ~$140M enterprise value — consisting of a ~$54M base purchase price plus repayment of ~$88M in credit facility debt. The all-cash deal signed and closed simultaneously on April 24, 2026. Key employees may receive up to $3M in earn-out payments over three years tied to net income thresholds. No board recommendation or advisor named. The filing is an 8-K reporting completion of acquisition. Watch for post-closing purchase price adjustments and earn-out performance metrics.
